name: Mutou Yuki
source: One of the big three and main actor of drama club. She is very popular among girls because of her manly and cool demeanor. She is interested in Julia's rough manners (because Julia/Saruyoshi is still not used to act like a girl yet) and always tries to approach her to learn about how to behave like a man for acting purpose. She is not really against the school merging idea from the beginning.
